description: Calculate deck board rows, total linear feet/meters, boards to buy, and deck screw count.

boardLength.description: Length of each purchased board (ft in us, default 16; m in metric, default 4.8).

boardWidth.description: Actual board width (in in us, default 5.5; mm in metric, default 140).

gap.description: Gap between boards (in in us, default 0.125; mm in metric, default 3).

joistSpacing.description: On-center joist spacing (in in us, default 16; mm in metric, default 400).

lengthAlongBoards.description: Deck dimension parallel to the boards (ft in us, m in metric).

widthAcrossBoards.description: Deck dimension across the boards (ft in us, m in metric).
